about.label: Info
about.title: Roughly this
about.bio1: Hi, I’m Lauta. I love learning new things: a programming paradigm, a design pattern, a framework, or some hobby that has nothing to do with any of it and ends up giving me ideas.
about.bio2: I learn by doing. I get hooked on whatever I just discovered, and I ask a lot of questions. What I enjoy most is working with talented people from other fields: together we get to places I’m not sure I’d reach alone.
about.bio3: I speak English and I’m learning German (A1 for now). Languages fascinate me: each one is a different way of looking at the world. If something to make together comes out of this, welcome.

pulso.desc: Running a digital studio for professionals and small businesses. Building websites and landing pages focused on lead generation, with form integrations, email automation, and light analytics. Hands-on with clients across content architecture and messaging.

ant.desc: Built and maintained corporate dashboards and internal web applications in an Agile/Scrum environment. Worked across the full stack: React + Redux + Material UI on the frontend, C# + .NET + Entity Framework on the backend, SQL Server for data, and Docker for deployment. Used Jira and Bitbucket for team collaboration.

coneq.desc: Developed the corporate site for an engineering and construction company. Implemented a multilanguage system with react-i18next, interactive map with LeafletJS, contact form via EmailJS, and full responsive design across mobile, tablet, and desktop.

qxm.desc: Built landing pages and interactive dashboards for a digital HR platform. Worked with React and Angular on the frontend, collaborating with a NestJS + SQL backend team.

brief.desc: Your daily Brief: news from multiple sources, categorized and summarized with AI into a daily digest in Spanish and English. An n8n workflow pulls the articles, processes them and stores them on its own, with no manual intervention. The site works offline and generates its own share images.

pulso.desc: A platform for agencies: clients and prospects, agile project management with kanban and sprints, finance, a content calendar, ad campaigns and a media library. Plus a Studio with a per-client brand kit and a visual editor for design pieces.

crew.desc: A platform for boutique gyms (climbing, crossfit, yoga): QR check-in, classes, plans and payments, with each gym's own branding. Multi-tenant, with subscriptions through Mercado Pago.

insurance.desc: Management system for Monteca, insurance advisors: clients, vehicles, contracts and policies, PDF receipts with barcodes, cash register and role-based access. A separate service sends daily email and WhatsApp reminders for upcoming installments and policy renewals. Plus its own landing page to bring in new clients.

noodle.desc: For learning guitar and music theory by ear: tuner, interactive fretboard with scales, theory, a songbook with transposition and an ear trainer. Works offline and installs as an app.
